headline: Court Approves $7 Billion Bayer Settlement Over Roundup Cancer Claims
summary: A court approved a $7 billion nationwide settlement agreement resolving legal claims alleging Bayer AG's glyphosate-based herbicide Roundup caused non-Hodgkin lymphoma in users.
why: Bayer acquired Monsanto in 2018 and has faced years of costly litigation in U.S. courts over Roundup. Resolving major legal liabilities provides clarity on future financial contingent reserves.

impacts.name: Bayer AG
impacts.why: Court approval of the $7 billion deal helps resolve longstanding litigation uncertainty.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Approval of the $7 billion settlement reduced downside legal risks surrounding Bayer's herbicide liabilities.
